messages:
Natalie: FYI customer (org: org_78a2) reports Manager role sees empty charts in Console -> Usage / Metrics since ~2026-03-09. Admins see full history. Ticket #46812. Anyone seen role-related missing data before?

Priya: Thanks, Natalie. Can you paste the org id, a sample user id, and which charts are blank? quick check: are they using "last 7 days" or custom range?

Natalie: org_78a2, user u_99321 (Manager). Charts: API Requests, Token Usage, and 99th latency all blank. Time range: "Last 30 days" and also custom 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-15. Admin in same org sees data.

Alex: pinging eng-analytics — first thought: permission filter for non-admins might be accidentally applied as a retention window. Can someone check the metrics pipeline + read-layer gating?

Sam: I can check ingestion + retention. analytics-batch writes to metrics_agg_v2 with per-tenant retention TTL. If read-layer applies a role filter, that could cap results. Will grep logs for org_78a2 around 2026-03-09.

analytics-bot: index_lookup: org=org_78a2, table=metrics_agg_v2, rows_last_write=2026-03-08T22:11:04Z, retention_ttl_days=90

Alex: Interesting — table TTL 90d so persistent. But there was a recent change in product that adds role-based scoping in the read service (PR #4123, deployed 2026-03-08). Possible bug: scoping defaulted to 7d for non-admins.

Jorge: Confirming PR #4123 introduced a new flag analytics.scope_by_role. Intention: hide org-level sensitive breakdowns for non-admins, not to shorten retention. Looks like defaultTTLForScopedReads was set incorrectly. Assigning to eng-analytics.

Priya: Customer is on a paid plan and needs this data for Manager role. Any temporary workaround we can give them?

Alex: Short-term workaround: grant the Manager the analytics.view_all permission or make them an Admin; or run a quick backfill to surface last 30d for their role. Repro steps for eng: 1) impersonate Manager (curl header X-Impersonate: u_99321) 2) GET /api/console/metrics?org=org_78a2&range=2026-03-01..2026-03-15 3) observe empty arrays.

Sam: I ran a query against read-service logs: for impersonation u_99321 the read filter applied WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' -- confirmed. Root cause looks like defaultTTLForScopedReads=7d.

Alex: Proposed fix: change defaultTTLForScopedReads -> 90d in config and ship a hotfix to read-service; add unit test that ensures scoped reads do not shorten retention. Also add migration to backfill 7d->90d for affected orgs.

Jorge: Agreed. Prioritize as P1 for analytics read-service. I'll schedule rollout & coordinate notice to SRE.

Priya: I'll respond to the customer: apology, explain bug, provide temporary workaround (grant view_all or admin) and ETA for hotfix (estimate 3-6 hours). Will include repro steps and we can update ticket with the fix once deployed.

Natalie: Customer updated: Manager temporarily granted admin to unblock analytics. Please update ticket with final rc. Thanks everyone :heart:

Alex: I'll open a follow-up thread with the PR link and changelog after the hotfix lands.

Sam: Deploying patch to staging now, will run integration tests against org_78a2.

analytics-bot: deploy_status: staging=true, run_tests=integration(org_78a2), expected_prod_rollout=2026-03-17T23:00:00Z

Jorge: After deploy, let's add a post-deploy check: sample 10 orgs with mixed roles and verify metrics parity between Admin and Manager views.

Natalie: noted, ticket owner will close once post-deploy checks pass.

Priya: Thanks all.
